[FACT] User has a Samsung Galaxy S21 that they have owned for about 6 months.  
[FACT] User paid around $800 for the Samsung Galaxy S21 at Best Buy.  
[PREFERENCE] User is experiencing issues with their Samsung Galaxy S21's battery life and is unsure of the cause.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offered to help troubleshoot the battery life issues with the Samsung Galaxy S21.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that it's not uncommon for battery life to degrade slightly over time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed potential culprits for battery drain: Android updates, resource-intensive apps, background processes, power-hungry features, and cache/data issues.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided troubleshooting steps: restart the phone, disable animations, limit background data usage, adjust screen settings, and perform a factory reset.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested visiting a Samsung authorized service center or contacting Samsung support if the issue persists.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering resetting their phone to factory settings but is worried about losing data.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that resetting the phone can help with battery life and provided methods to back up data.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant detailed ways to back up data: using a Google account, Samsung Cloud, Google Photos, local backup via USB, and third-party apps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed what to back up: contacts, photos, SMS, call logs, apps, music, documents, and Wi-Fi passwords.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided steps for performing a factory reset.  
[PREFERENCE] User is particularly concerned about losing photos during the backup process.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that backing up photos to an external hard drive is possible and provided methods for doing so.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed methods for backing up photos to an external hard drive: using a USB OTG adapter, connecting to a computer, using wireless transfer, and cloud storage with local copies.  
[PREFERENCE] User has already backed up their photos to Google Photos.  
[PREFERENCE] User is unsure about the safety of external hard drives and their susceptibility to data loss or corruption.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant discussed the pros and cons of external hard drives, including local access, large storage capacity, physical damage, mechanical failure, and data corruption.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for minimizing risks when using external hard drives, such as choosing a reliable brand, storing it safely, and regularly checking the drive's health.
